        const tier = TIER_DATA[tierKey];

        tierBadge.textContent = tier.badge;
        tierSub.textContent = tier.sub;
        feat1.textContent = tier.feat1;
        feat2.textContent = tier.feat2;
        feat3.textContent = tier.feat3;
        feat4.textContent = tier.feat4;
      }

      // ======================================================================
      // EVENT LISTENERS
      // ======================================================================

      // Slider input
      slider.addEventListener('input', updateCalculator);

      // Window resize re-aligns tooltip thumb offset
      window.addEventListener('resize', updateCalculator);

      // Billing switchers
      btnMonthly.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (!isAnnual) return;
        isAnnual = false;
        btnMonthly.classList.add('is-active');
        btnMonthly.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
        btnAnnual.classList.remove('is-active');
        btnAnnual.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
        updateCalculator();
      });

      btnAnnual.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (isAnnual) return;
        isAnnual = true;
        btnAnnual.classList.add('is-active');
        btnAnnual.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
        btnMonthly.classList.remove('is-active');
        btnMonthly.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
        updateCalculator();
      });

      // Add-on checkboxes
      addonSsl.addEventListener('change', updateCalculator);
      addonSla.addEventListener('change', updateCalculator);

      // Milestone clicks
      milestones.forEach(function (node) {
        node.addEventListener('click', function () {
          const targetValue = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-val'), 10);
          slider.value = targetValue;
          updateCalculator();
        });
      });

      // Initialize on load
      updateCalculator();
    })();
      } catch(appErr) {
        console.warn('[APP LOGIC ERROR]', appErr);
      }
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initDynamicComponentLogic);
  } else {
    initDynamicComponentLogic();
  }
  setTimeout(initDynamicComponentLogic, 200);
  setTimeout(initDynamicComponentLogic, 800);
  window.addEventListener('elementor/frontend/init', initDynamicComponentLogic);
})();
</script>
